prompt:
A 3-column by 2-row grid of 6 circular pirate achievement badge emblems, hand-painted game-art style, soft painterly shading with a subtle inner glow and a beveled metal rim. Each badge is a round medallion coin centered in its own cell with generous transparent margin around it. Transparent background. No text, no numbers, no letters anywhere. Consistent lighting, consistent medallion size across all six. Each badge's metal tier: bronze = humble, silver = accomplished, gold = elite, ornate jeweled gold = legendary. Across this set an eerie crimson inner glow grows steadily stronger from the first badge to the last.

Read left-to-right, top row then bottom row:

Ancient Tackle (silver) — a heavy fishing hook forged from black ancient bone, barbed and pitted with age, a faint crimson light bleeding along its inner curve.
Something Old (silver) — a single fossilised tooth-shard the size of a dagger, grey and cracked, seated in a plain brass mount, cold and inert with no light in it yet.
Waking It (silver) — the same fossilised tooth-shard in its brass mount, now split by a hairline fracture with crimson light spilling out of the crack.
Fully Attuned (ornate jeweled gold) — the tooth-shard relic blazing crimson-white in its mount, six concentric rings of light expanding outward around it, the metal glowing with the heat of it.
Both in Hand (gold) — two ancient relics crossed over one another on a brass rack, one a bone hook, one a tooth-shard, both lit with the same low crimson glow.
The Sixth Mount (silver) — a curved section of a ship's gun rail seen from above with six mounting cradles set into it, every cradle filled with ancient kit, the sixth and last glowing brightest.
